description: Smooth wrapped-Gaussian periodic continuation of the finite piecewise-sin^2 convergent basin; direct steady characteristics
notes: Surface and bed are parallel; thickness is constant.
Cyclic accumulation zones are split into flow-directed source families at sampled surface-u sign changes.
Positive islands carrying <0.1% of total accumulation flux are rejected as interpolation noise.

Negative minima are narrow and source-sampling sensitive; the refined sign persists under a quarter-period gauge translation, while the magnitude is not converged. No sampled case has negative per-source p01 J.
